ios.desc:
Sift Connect puts your entire organization at your finger tips.

Sift brings effortless transparency to your organization on the go: enabling everyone on your team to quickly connect with their colleagues via phone, SMS, or email even if they're out of the office.

Features:

- Powerful tolerant search to instantly connect you with the right people in your organization
- Call, text, or email any of your colleagues with one click
- All the information about your colleagues in one place: photos, bios, skills, interests and contact information
- Listing of your company and team, as well as your recent connections
- Interactive hierarchy makes it easy to connect with a colleagues leader or team if they are unavailable

quotes.text:
Our app, Sift Connect, was built entirely with React Native. I started the project with no android or iOS experience.
We have a collective ~1000 daily active users and a 70 NP score.

iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/sift-connect/id1213640928?mt=8

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.justsift.connect
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What popular apps were made exclusively with React Native or Flutter?
